comment: Shared style suffixes appended to every prompt (see docs/art-bible.md). Each asset picks one via its `style` field.

suffixes.background: Hand-painted 2D game background art in a warm, earthy, low-saturation palette, painterly brush texture, soft atmospheric perspective, medieval European fantasy, side-scrolling game layer, clean readable shapes, no characters, no people, no animals, no text, no logos, no frame, no border, no watermark.
suffixes.texture: Hand-painted 2D game texture, warm earthy low-saturation palette, painterly brush texture, flat even lighting with no cast shadows and no vignette, uniform density across the whole image, viewed straight on, no objects, no characters, no text, no logos, no frame, no border, no watermark.
suffixes.illustration: Hand-painted 2D storybook illustration for a medieval action game, warm earthy low-saturation palette with only magic effects vivid, painterly brush texture, soft directional light, atmospheric depth, stylised heroic proportions with broad shoulders, oversized swords and large shields, readable helmets, strong silhouettes, cinematic composition, no gore, no text, no lettering, no logos, no frame, no border, no watermark.
suffixes.portrait: Hand-painted 2D character bust portrait for a medieval action game, painterly brush texture, warm earthy low-saturation palette, soft directional key light from the upper left with a subtle warm rim light, stylised heroic proportions with broad shoulders, consistent framing: head and shoulders, three-quarter view facing slightly to the right, centred, top of the helmet about 10% below the top edge, chest cut off at the bottom edge, plain dark charcoal-brown background with a soft vignette, no text, no lettering, no frame, no border, no watermark.
suffixes.icon: Simple bold painted game UI emblem icon, single centred object filling about 80% of the canvas, thick dark brown outline, chunky simplified shapes, flat painterly shading, warm muted palette of aged gold, bronze, iron and parchment, strong silhouette readable at 32 pixels, isolated on a fully transparent background, no text, no letters, no numbers, no frame, no circle badge behind it, no drop shadow, no watermark.
suffixes.keyart: Hand-painted 2D key art for a medieval action game, warm earthy low-saturation palette, painterly brush texture, dramatic soft directional light, atmospheric depth, stylised heroic proportions with oversized sword and large shield, epic but calm cinematic composition, no text, no title, no lettering, no logos, no frame, no border, no watermark.
